preconditions.description: The length of string s must be between 1 and 1,000,000 characters.
The number of queries n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(xi) <= 10**6 for xi in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query string xi must have a length between 1 and 1,000,000 characters.
All query strings xi must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n lines, one for each query.
Each output line must be a non-negative integer representing the count of cyclical isomorphic substrings.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.splitlines()[i]) <= len(s) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output count must not exceed the length of string s.
